enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Shift legs. Turn again. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wash face. Apply soap. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast (toast and tea)
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and butter. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out plate. Place bread on plate. Open drawer. Take out knife. Spread butter on bread. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Open cupboard. Take out mug. Fill kettle with water. Plug in kettle. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out tea bag. Place tea bag in mug. Wait for kettle to boil. Pour hot water into mug. Remove tea bag. Add milk from refrigerator. Stir tea. Take toast from toaster. Place on plate. Sit at table. Pick up toast. Eat toast. Sip tea. Finish breakfast. Pick up plate and mug. Walk to sink. Rinse plate and mug. Place in dish rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing study materials, laptop and notes for university
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open backpack. Place laptop in backpack. Place notebooks in backpack. Place pen case in backpack. Zip backpack. Pick up phone from nightstand. Check time. Put phone in pocket. Pick up backpack. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put on headphones. Play music. Adjust volume. Get off bus. Walk to campus. Enter campus.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending Master of Education lectures and tutorials
enriched_activities.desc: Enter lecture hall. Find seat. Sit down. Open laptop. Take notes. Raise hand. Ask question. Listen to lecturer. Write notes. Discuss in group. Present ideas. Write more notes. Close laptop. Stand up. Walk to next tutorial room.

enriched_activities.activity: Buying and eating lunch on campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Join queue. Order sandwich. Pay. Receive sandwich. Find table. Sit down. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Throw trash. Stand up. Walk away.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying in the campus library and attending a research methods seminar
enriched_activities.desc: Enter library. Find desk. Sit down. Open laptop. Open textbook. Read chapter. Highlight text. Write notes. Open seminar room. Sit down. Listen to speaker. Take notes. Ask question. Discuss with peer. Close laptop. Pack bag. Leave library.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Look out window. Adjust backpack. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, washing up dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open fridge. Take out vegetables and meat. Close fridge. Take out cutting board and knife. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables and meat. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish. Pick up dishes. Walk to sink. Wash dishes. Place in rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on assignment drafts on the computer under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Open assignment file. Read prompt. Type sentences. Delete text. Retype. Save file. Open browser. Search for reference. Copy citation. Paste into document. Format text. Check word count. Stretch arms. Continue typing. Save file. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp.
Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch show. Pick up phone. Scroll social media. Put down phone. Watch more TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading course notes and going to sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Pick up course notes. Sit on bed. Read notes. Highlight key points. Put notes on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Sleep.
